notes.title: Diesel Guns. Alpha v0.9.3 Hotfix
notes.content:
[list]
* Fix: sniper aiming mode
* Fix: switching camera mode with "Z" key
* Fix: Camera FOV in "Rampage" mode
* Fix: switching weapons with number keys
* Fix: mortar alt-fire (wasn't able to see targets)
* Fix: now the hover vehicle is lower
* Changed: the location of respawn points in "Bomb" mode
* New: the launch trailer is played when the game starts
* Optimization: particle systems
* Optimization: "bomb" mode map
[/list]

notes.title: Diesel Guns Alpha v0.9.3.0
notes.content:
Release notes:
[list]
New: flying vehicle class added
New: "X-3N" added
New: new map "Arabian Night" added
New: German language
New: added vinyls for all vehicles
New: the ability to paint all vehicles
Changed: VFX of rampage mode
Changed: "Exorcist's" alt-fire requires 10 shells and deals double damage
Changed: homing flood missiles
Changed: match time reduced to 10 minutes
Changed: the interval between "Thunderbolt's" shots increased 2 times
Changed: “Railgun” alt-fire impulse increased 3 times
Changed: time-to-kill reduced by 20%
Changed: increased speed of all classes except supercar
Changed: Shark's vampirism increased by 50%
Optimization: bot AI
Optimization: vehicle textures
Fix: drone "Tesla" didn't count kills
Fix: "Pest" did not kill in some cases
[/list]
